scope: Read-only comparison of queued supervisor adoption vs legacy runner extension; no product edits/network/delegation/publication
findings: Queued supervisor admission avoids daemon lock contention. Preserve original fill-history start and actual first fill separate from admission time. Atomically import entry/SL ownership, reject legacy/reused IDs, require complete flat-to-long ledger/current position and fixed SL; imported orders must not acquire agent-origin attribution. These findings informed revision4/investigation and manual_adoption design.
limitations: Research only, not implementation verification or PR review
